methods: Exact real-root exclusion and branch substitution

arithmetic.scope: Every prime q>2d+1, over the algebraic closure, for d=2,3
arithmetic.proof: Integer nilpotence identities exclude other primes; explicit nonzero witnesses include all listed primes.

generic_model_smoke.meaning: Every preset with symbolic parameters returned a profile result for each family; conditional and no_match results are retained as such.

limitations: No general multivariate parameter solver; exact conditions are retained.
Completeness is within the one-pole autonomous branch; the paper states when its meromorphic classification applies.
The reference catalogue contains real pairs only; the constructor is independent of it and allows complex coefficients.
